channel.title: Claimball Journal
channel.description: Notes from the making of Claimball, a casual duel game against AI rivals on a notebook grid.

item.title: Combos, Fever and stars: how a Claimball match builds up
item.description: Build 5 added combo chains, a Fever mode in the last 20 seconds, one to three stars per match and a list of achievements.

item.title: Two looks for Claimball: Classic and Notebook
item.description: Notebook is a paper-and-grid-notebook style that matches the Claimball website, and you can switch any time in Settings.

item.title: The Daily Challenge: one match a day with a twist
item.description: One match a day with a twist, a fairer rematch balance, and what happens if the app closes mid-match.

item.title: Continue on another device with iCloud
item.description: Your progress, stars, achievements and accessibility settings follow your iCloud account on iPhone and iPad. Here is what is shared and what is not.

item.title: Claimball speaks 13 languages in the test builds
item.description: From nine languages to thirteen, plus an automatic check that keeps every translation complete.

item.title: Color-blind patterns: telling tiles apart without relying on color
item.description: A setting adds dots on your tiles and stripes on the opponent's, and text contrast was improved in both looks.

item.title: Claimball can be read aloud with VoiceOver and handles large text
item.description: Build 14 announces every part of a match with VoiceOver and keeps layouts intact at large text sizes and on small screens.

item.title: Your first Claimball match now starts with a short guide
item.description: A three-card How to play guide greets you on your first match in the latest test builds.

item.title: My Stats and background music arrive in Claimball
item.description: The latest test build adds a My Stats screen with your wins, draws and losses, and three original music tracks with an on/off toggle.

item.title: How a tied match ends in Claimball
item.description: A tie used to end in a confusing result. Here is how sudden death works now, and what changed in the latest test builds.

item.title: Starting to make Claimball
item.description: The first journal post. What Claimball is, and why this journal exists.
